Record Class CompilationMetrics

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.github.jabrena.juno.CompilationMetrics
Record Components:
assemblyBytes - UTF-8 bytes in the generated assembly source
runtimeShimBytes - UTF-8 bytes in the generated C++ runtime shim
generatedMethods - generated assembly functions
assemblyInstructions - non-directive assembly instructions
loadInstructions - ARM load instructions (ldr*)
storeInstructions - ARM store instructions (str*)
branchInstructions - conditional and unconditional branches, excluding calls
callInstructions - branch-with-link calls
directAllocationCalls - direct calls to juno_alloc
maximumFixedFrameBytes - largest generated method frame, including saved registers
totalFixedFrameBytes - sum of generated method frames, including saved registers
public record CompilationMetrics(int assemblyBytes, int runtimeShimBytes, int generatedMethods, int assemblyInstructions, int loadInstructions, int storeInstructions, int branchInstructions, int callInstructions, int directAllocationCalls, int maximumFixedFrameBytes, int totalFixedFrameBytes) extends Record
Deterministic structural measurements of one Juno compilation.

These measurements are deliberately independent of host timing: they can be compared in tests and CI without mistaking a faster build machine for a compiler optimization. Instruction counts describe Juno's generated assembly source; final flash/RAM sizes still come from the Arduino toolchain's ELF, and execution cycles still need the target board.
